result.stdout:
Grappe — a static site framework for .NET and Blazor.
Run any command from inside a Grappe site's project folder.

Usage:
  grappe build               Build the static site into ./output
  grappe serve               Run a local dev server with live-reload
                              (run under `dotnet watch --project <site> -- serve`
                              for Razor/C# hot reload — see grappe-roadmap.md)
  grappe new page <title>    Scaffold a new Markdown page in Content/
  grappe new post <title>    Scaffold a new Markdown blog post in Content/blog/

  grappe --help, -h          Show this message
  grappe --version, -v       Show the installed version

Examples:
  grappe new page "About me"
  grappe build
  grappe serve
